name: manual_7e600f
claim: A global npm install lands in the prefix of whichever node comes first on PATH only when npm uses its default prefix: set PATH explicitly for the install and print npm -g config get prefix in the same command; when NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX or npm configuration overrides the prefix, check and correct the effective prefix before installing, or the package lands under the wrong node and the intended copy stays stale.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit on PR 523: PATH selects the Node install only for npm's default prefix; NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX or npm config can still divert the global install.

rationale: CodeRabbit on PR 523: PATH selects the Node install only for npm's default prefix; NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX or npm config can still divert the global install.
